task: Implement order-status transitions. Statuses: pending, paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled. Write can_transition(current, target) -> bool where pending->paid->shipped->delivered is the forward path and anything except delivered can also move to cancelled.

constraints.text: order statuses live in an Enum, not loose strings
constraints.why: a 'canceled' vs 'cancelled' spelling mismatch in 2025-12 let refunded orders keep shipping for a week

checks.description: statuses not modeled as an Enum

constraints.text: status logic never compares against string literals
constraints.why: a trailing space in a 'shipped ' literal skipped every delivery email in 2026-02

checks.description: compares status to a string literal

constraints.text: allowed transitions live in a data mapping instead of an if/elif ladder
constraints.why: the 2026-03 ladder in the shipping code dropped the delivered guard and nobody caught it in review
